01

“O mankind, fear your Lord, who created you from one soul”

Four explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr and ʿIkrima (Q 4:1).

175
Explanation from Mujāhid No. 175 : 1: 1

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
175: 1:1. Abu Hudhayfa related to us; Sufyan related to us, from a man, from Mujahid, on His words
"O mankind, fear your Lord, who created you from one soul": He said, Adam, "and created from it its mate": he said, Eve was created from his rib (verse 1).
العربية
175 : 1: 1 حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حُذَيْفَةَ ثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ مجاهد في قوله يا أيها النَّاسُ اتَّقُوا رَبَّكُمُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ من نفس واحدة قَالَ آدَمُ وَخَلَقَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا قَالَ حَوَّاءُ خُلِقَتْ مِنْ ضِلْعِهِ (الآية 1) .

06

“And when the relatives, the orphans, and the poor attend the…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 4:8).

196
Explanation from Mujāhid No. 196: 22: 15

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
196: 22:15. Sufyan, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, who said:
What the heirs freely give is the duty, on His words "And when the relatives, the orphans, and the poor attend the division," the verse. He said, that they give a modest gift to their relatives if the heirs are adults; and if they are minors, the guardian says, "They are minors and I own nothing of it" (verse 8).
العربية
196: 22: 15 سفيان عن بن أَبِي نَجِيحٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ قَالَ وَاجِبُهُ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْمِيرَاثِ مَا طَابَتْ بِهِ أَنْفُسُهُمْ فِي قَوْلِهِ وإذا حضر القسمة أولوا القربى واليتامى والمساكين الآية قَالَ أَنْ يَرْضَخُوا لِأَقَارِبِهِمْ إِنْ كَانَ الْوَرَثَةُ كِبَارًا وَإِنْ كَانُوا صغارا قال الوصي هم صفار ولست أملك منه شيئا (الآية 8) .
Edition record 371328 · p. 89Link to report ↗
07

“And let those fear [God] who, if they left behind weak offspring…”

Two explanations transmitted from Habib ibn Abi Thabit and Ibrāhīm (Q 4:9).

197
Explanation from Habib ibn Abi Thabit No. 197: 23: 16

Habib ibn Abi Thabit

English
Transmission wording
197: 23:16. Sufyan, from Habib ibn Abi Thabit, who said:
I and al-Hakam went to Said ibn Jubayr and I asked him about the words of God "And let those fear [God] who, if they left behind weak offspring, would fear for them": He said, the witnesses who are present at the [making of the will] say ⦗p. 90⦘ "Fear God, maintain ties with them, be good to them, give to them," even though they themselves would not do so and would not like to leave [anything] for their own children; they command him but do not do it themselves. Then we went to Miqsam, who said, "Whatever Said said." We told him, and he said, "No, rather they say: 'Fear God, do not make a bequest, hold on to it for your child,' and if the one for whom he is making the bequest were their own children, they would like him to make a bequest for them" (verse 9).
العربية
197: 23: 16 سفيان عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ قَالَ انْطَلَقْتُ أَنَا وَالْحَكَمُ إِلَى سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ وَلْيَخْشَ الَّذِينَ لَوْ تَرَكُوا مِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّةً ضِعَافًا خافوا عليهم قَالَ الشُّهُودُ الَّذِينَ يَحْضُرُونَهُ يَقُولُونَ ⦗p. 90⦘ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ صِلْهُمْ بِرَّهُمْ أَعْطِهِمْ وَلَوْ كَانُوا هُمْ مَا فَعَلُوا وَلَا حَبُّوا أَنْ يُبْقُوا لِأَوْلَادِهِمْ يَأْمُرُونَهُ وَلَا يَفْعَلُونَ هُمْ فَأَتَيْنَا مِقْسَمًا فَقَالَ مَا قَالَ سَعِيدٌ فَأَخْبَرْنَاهُ فَقَالَ لَا وَلَكِنْ يَقُولُونَ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ لَا تُوصِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَى وَلَدِكَ وَلَوْ كَانَ الَّذِي يوصي له أولادهم لأحبوا أن يوصي لهم (الآية 9) .
Edition record 371328 371329 · pp. 89–90Link to report ↗

202
Explanation from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad No. 202: 28: 21

al-Qasim ibn Muhammad

English
Transmission wording
202: 28:21. Sufyan, from Yahya ibn Said, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, who said:
I was in the care of Ibn Abbas when a bedouin came to him and said, "O Abbas, I have orphans in my care. They have camels and I have camels. I lend out milk camels and lend out mounts. What of their milk is lawful for me?" “And if you fear a breach between the two, send an arbiter from his…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 4:35).

215
Explanation from Mujāhid No. 215: 41: 55

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
215: 41:55. Sufyan, from Abu Hashim, from Mujahid, on His words
"And if you fear a breach between the two, send an arbiter from his people and an arbiter from her people": [The woman sends her arbiter,] and she informs him of her situation and says, "He does such and such," and she says, "What do you think? If you advise him about anything, advise him." And the man sends an arbiter from his side, who is told that she does such and such. The two arbiters are empowered to separate them if they see separation, or to reconcile them if they see reconciliation. God Almighty said, "If they both desire reconciliation, God will bring about agreement between them": He said, they meet and each informs the other of what his companion said. Then they look: if the fault is on her side, they turn to her, and if the fault is on his side, ⦗p. 95⦘ they turn to him, and if they see separation, they separate them (verse 35).
العربية
215: 41: 55 سفيان عَنْ أَبِي هَاشِمٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ فِي قَوْلِهِ وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ شِقَاقَ بَيْنِهِمَا فَابْعَثُوا حَكَمًا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ وحكما من أهلها وَتُخْبِرُهُ بِأَمْرِهَا وَتَقُولُ إِنَّهُ يَفْعَلُ كذى وكذى وتقول أرأيت ان تعظه على شئ فاعظه وَيَبْعَثُ الرَّجُلُ حَكَمًا مِنْ قِبَلِهِ فيخبره انها تفعل كذى وكذى ويأمرانهما ثنا بِالْفُرْقَةِ إِنْ رَأَيَا الْفُرْقَةَ أَوِ الجمع ان رأيا الخمع به قال الله جل وعز ان يريدا أصلاحا يوفق ابينهما قَالَ يَتَصَادَفَانِ فَيُخْبِرُ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا مَا قَالَ صَاحِبُهُ ثُمَّ يَنْظُرَانِ فَإِنْ كَانَ الزُّرْقُ مِنْ قِبَلِهَا أَقْبَلا عَلَيْهَا وَإِنْ كَانَ الزُّرْقُ مِنْ قِبَلِهِ، ⦗p. 95⦘ أَقْبَلا عَلَيْهِ وَإِنْ رَأَيَا الْفُرْقَةَ فرقا (الآية 35) .

An explanation transmitted from Abu Bakr ibn Abi Zuhayr (Q 4:123).

227
Explanation from Abu Bakr ibn Abi Zuhayr No. 227: 53: 28

Abu Bakr ibn Abi Zuhayr

English
Transmission wording
227: 53:28. Sufyan, from Ismail ibn Abi Khalid, from Abu Bakr ibn Abi Zuhayr, who said:
Abu Bakr said, "O Messenger of God, how can there be [any] improvement after this verse, 'Whoever does evil will be recompensed for it'? If we do evil, we will be recompensed for it." He said, "May God forgive you, Abu Bakr" three times. "Do you not fall ill? Do you not become weary? Do you not meet with hardship? That is among what you are recompensed with in this world" (verse 123).

“Ali said to him”

An explanation transmitted from Yusay (Q 4:141).

228
Explanation from Yusay No. 228: 54: 29

Yusay

English
Transmission wording
228: 54:29. Sufyan, from al-Amash, from Dharr, from Yusay, who said:
A man came to Ali and said, "God, the Blessed and Exalted, has told us, 'God will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection, and never will God make for the disbelievers a way over the believers,' yet here are the believers being killed." Ali said to him, "Come closer. God will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection, and never will God make for the disbelievers a way over the believers" (verse 141).
